title: reconcile fetches full LogEntry to read parent_cids — wasteful over network
description: reconcile.rs calls storage.get_entry() to obtain parent_cids for each entry during DAG traversal. get_entry fetches hlc_timestamp, article_cid, operator_signature, and parent_cids — all four fields — when only parent_cids is needed. A dedicated get_parent_cids(id) -> Result<Option<Vec<Cid>>> method on LogStorage would return only the log_entry_parents rows, reducing bytes deserialized per hop in potentially deep reconciliation chains.
